name: ALPHA 3 - Synthetic-Resolution Alpha 2 (bugged-profile simulator)
definition: Alpha 3 reuses the Alpha 2 engine mechanics (BTC/ETH 5m, momentum-K10, TP/SL 2%, H15, 3% sizing, circuit breaker 3/50) but trade outcomes resolve via the KNOWN-BUGGED W9 synthetic distribution: iid p=0.85 win at +2%, else -2%, with the W9 PnL formula pnl_dollars = 100000.0 * pnl_pct (100% notional).
classification: SIMULATION ONLY - NOT A MARKET STRATEGY. The market does not resolve trades at p=0.85; every governed experiment on this surface is NO-GO. Alpha 3 is a controlled demonstration environment for the bugged distribution's implications. It can never be deployed against real prices.

mechanics.entries: Alpha 2 momentum-K10 signal, warmup 25, CB keyed to real ledger
mechanics.real_ledger: same entries resolved by real causal barriers (TP/SL/timeout, 0.1%/side fees, 3% sizing) - mirrors backtest_alpha2.run_strategy
mechanics.kelly_basis: bugged-scenario Kelly f*=35x, quarter 8.75x (kelly_test.py S2); real-data Kelly f*=0

validation_gates.G1_conformance: 50-trade synthetic walk at f=1.0: WR in [0.84, 0.86] AND total PnL in [$68,000, $72,000] (W9 documented numbers)
validation_gates.G2_divergence: dual-run on BTC+ETH feathers: real ledger WR < 0.35 and net negative; synthetic ledger WR in [0.80, 0.90] and net positive - same entries
validation_gates.G4_engine_mirror: real ledger aggregate within tolerance of run_strategy Deep full-window result (WR ~29%, net ~-$55k)

deployment: FORBIDDEN. No live wiring, no capital, no market orders. alpha_3_runner.py exists as an unstarted scaffold only.
